# Accredian: Program Catalogue

> Accredian is an executive upskilling platform in India. It offers live online executive programs, post-graduate certificates and CXO leadership tracks in AI, management, strategy, finance, HR and project management, in partnership with IIMs, IITs, XLRI, SP Jain and Microsoft.

Fees, start dates and enrollment status change over time. Check the linked program page for current details before relying on anything here. For admissions questions use https://accredian.com/contact-us.

- [Contact and admissions](https://accredian.com/contact-us)

## Programs open for admission

### [Design Thinking](https://accredian.com/course/design-thinking)

#### [Advanced Certificate Program in Design Thinking & Innovation with AI](https://accredian.com/programs/advanced-certificate-program-in-design-thinking-innovation-with-ai)
- **Institution:** E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur
- **Duration:** 5 Months
- **Start date:** 27 Sep 2026
- **Experience required:** 1+ years
- **Fee:** INR 1,50,000 + GST
- **Description:** Embark on a 5 month learning journey in Design Thinking, Applied Innovation & Creative Problem Solving. 
- **Curriculum:**
  1. Design Thinking & Human-Centered Innovation
  2. Customer Discovery & AI-Powered Insights
  3. AI-Augmented Ideation & Creative Problem Solving
  4. Prototyping, Experimentation & Validation
  5. Product, Service & Experience Design
  6. Capstone Project

#### [Executive Program in Design Thinking & Innovation for Strategic Leadership](https://accredian.com/programs/iith-executive-program-in-design-thinking-and-innovation-for-strategic-leadership)
- **Institution:** Department of Entrepreneurship and Management, IIT Hyderabad
- **Duration:** 6 Months
- **Start date:** 28 Jun 2026
- **Experience required:** 1+ years
- **Fee:** INR 1,79,000 + GST
- **Description:** Embark on a 6 month learning journey in Applied Innovation, Experience Design & Strategic Leadership.
- **Curriculum:**
  1. Design Thinking & Innovation Foundations
  2. Design Thinking Process & Methods
  3. Applied Innovation & Experience Design
  4. Competitive Strategy & Strategic Direction
  5. Business Models & Value Creation
  6. Capstone Project
